items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My mother was named Rose. She was of the Barbarin family... That’s her brothers you call. Paul’s a brother. Willie’s a brother. Lucien’s a brother. Paul, Willie, Lucien, and Louis. They all played music

ctx.x: Isidore Barbarin. And he walked at home, and we listened. He used to play a little melody or something, and he’s watching. He’s pacing hisself, because you can get rusty. You get out of the pace, you get out of the pace of the rhythm that you’re playing, because them bands march at a certain tempo and a certain pace, and that’s what he practiced.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: They called him Isidore, Isidore Barbarin.

ctx.x: What was the old man's name?
